scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/ui && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.build:server: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w server
scripts.build:client: npm run build -w packages/ui && npm run build -w client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w client
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules packages/*/node_modules server/node_modules client/node_modules packages/*/dist server/dist client/dist
